name: eval2: the case's close-ups on the sofa, not a wooden floor (MOTH-148).
notes: Only the background changes; the old case pixels are kept by script so the packed pieces still line up. Linted.

cases.prompt: Attached picture 1 is finished and approved. The suitcase itself, and everything in or on it, stays exactly as it is. Nothing else changes anywhere. No words, letters, numbers or symbols anywhere in the picture.
cases.note: MOTH-148: the open case close up on the sofa, as in the room
